description: Naming conventions OWNED BY the automation skill: regression-suite layer files, registry files, and the feature git branch. Not shared — each skill holds only the naming rules it produces.
_pathNote: Every 'regression-suite/...' location below means the PER-APP suite resolved in SKILL Step 0 from pipeline-config.json → apps[appKey].suiteDir (e.g. qe-pipeline/output/regression-suite-BREW/). Suites are isolated per app; there is no single shared regression-suite/.

rules: APP = the resolved app key (story prefix, e.g. BREW/TCOE) — app-agnostic; never hardcode a specific app
DOMAIN = the business domain in UPPER-KEBAB (from the app's domain map / @domain tag)
VERB = the capability action in UPPER-KEBAB (CREATE, VALIDATE, SEARCH, VALIDATE-EMAIL, ...)
Stable, human-readable business identity for a reusable flow/service method
One capability ID maps to exactly one implementation {file, method} in service-catalog/flow entries
Reused across stories — the AI searches by capability ID before generating a new method
Business scenario identity in scenario-catalog.json
Composes one or more capability IDs
app-agnostic — APP is resolved at runtime
Flat directory, no subdirectories
Feature name uses kebab-case (may include domain prefix for readability, e.g. checkout-place-order.spec.ts)
Domain is expressed via the @domain tag, not a folder
Extension must be .spec.ts
One fixture per domain
Name matches the domain it serves
Extension must be .fixture.ts
Flat directory, no subdirectories
Name uses kebab-case describing the cross-feature path
Composes MULTIPLE flows; contains no pages/services/locators
Extension must be .journey.ts
Flat directory, no subdirectories
Journey name uses kebab-case (may include domain prefix for readability, e.g. checkout-place-order.flow.ts)
Single-domain capability; may compose a page (UI) and/or a service (API)
Extension must be .flow.ts
Flat directory, no subdirectories
Name uses kebab-case describing the API area (API counterpart of a page)
Built on core ApiClient; no UI locators
Extension must be .service.ts
Flat directory, no subdirectories
Name uses kebab-case
Extension must be .page.ts
Flat directory, no subdirectories
Name uses kebab-case describing the widget
Extension must be .component.ts
Flat directory, no subdirectories
Name uses kebab-case describing the data area (usually matches a domain)
Exports typed constants + variations only — no logic/locators/API calls
Variations are entries passed into flow/service methods as params (never per-variant methods)
Extension must be .data.ts
Flat directory, no subdirectories
Name uses kebab-case
Plain .ts extension (no layer suffix)

flow-catalog.json.description: Maps flow names to file paths, associated domains, composed pages/services, and the capability IDs the flow implements

journey-catalog.json.description: Maps journey names to file paths and the ordered flows they compose (cross-feature)

service-catalog.json.description: Maps service names to file paths and the API capability IDs (with method) they implement

page-catalog.json.description: Maps page object names to file paths and owned locators

component-catalog.json.description: Maps component names to file paths and widget types

fixture-catalog.json.description: Maps fixture names to providers and injected dependencies

scenario-catalog.json.description: Maps business scenario IDs to the capability IDs they compose (business scenario -> capabilities -> implementation)

domain-index.json.description: Maps domain tags to associated tests, flows, journeys, and stories
